1.1: Shesh maalot bammikvaot, zo lemala mizzo, vezo lemala mizzo. me gevaim, shata tame veshata tahor, tame. shata tame umille vichli tahor, tame. shata tame venafal kikkar shel teruma, im hediach, tame. veim lo hediach, tahor:
1.2: Mille vichli tame veshata tahor, tame. mille vichli tame umille vichli tahor, tame. mille vichli tame venafal kikkar shel teruma, im hediach, tame. veim lo hediach, tahor:
1.3: Naflu mayim temeim veshata tahor, tame. naflu mayim temeim umille vichli tahor, tame. naflu mayim temeim venafal kikkar shel teruma, im hediach, tame. veim lo hediach, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, ben shehediach ben shello hediach, tame:
1.4: Nafal letochan met, o shehalach bahen hattame, veshata tahor, tahor. echad me gevaim, me vorot, me shichim, me mearot, me tamtziyyot sheppasku, umikvaot sheen bahem arbaim sea, bishat haggeshamim hakkol tahor. pasku haggeshamim, hakkerovim lair veladderech, temeim. veharchokim, tehorin, ad sheyyehallechu rov bene adam:
1.5: Meematay tohoratan. bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyirbu veyishtofu. uvet hillel omrim, rabbu af al pi shello shatfu. rabbi shimon omer, shatfu af al pi shello rabbu. kesherin lachalla velittol mehen layyadayim:
1.6: Lemala mehen, me tamtziyyot shello fasku. shata tame veshata tahor, tahor. shata tame umille vichli tahor, tahor. shata tame venafal kikkar shel teruma, af al pi shehediach, tahor. mille vichli tame veshata tahor, tahor. mille vichli tame umille vichli tahor, tahor. mille vichli tame venafal kikkar shel teruma, af al pi shehediach, tahor. naflu mayim temeim veshata tahor, tahor. naflu mayim temeim umille vichli tahor, tahor. naflu mayim temeim venafal kikkar shel teruma, af al pi shehediach, tahor. kesherim latteruma velittol mehem layyadayim:
1.7: Lemala mehen, mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea, shebbo tovlin umatbilin. lemala mehen, mayan shemmemav muatin verabbu alav mayim sheuvin, shave lammikve letaher beashboren, velammayan lehatebil bo bechol shehu:
1.8: Lemala mehen, mayim mukkin, shehen metaharin bezochalin. lemala mehen, mayim chayyim, shebbahen tevila lazzavim, vehazzaya lamtzoraim, uchesherim lekaddesh mehen me chattat:

2.1: Hattame sheyyarad litbol, safek taval safek lo taval, afillu taval, safek yesh bo arbaim sea safek en bo. shene mikvaot, echad yesh bo arbaim sea veechad sheen bo, taval beachad mehem veeno yodea beeze mehen taval, sefeko tame:
2.2: Mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser, kol tohorot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim, temeot. bamme devarim amurim, betuma chamura. aval betuma kalla, kegon achal ochalim temeim, veshata mashkin temeim, ba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvim, o shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, veyarad litbol, safek taval safek lo taval, afillu taval, safek yesh bo arbaim sea safek en bo. shene mikvaot, echad yesh bo arbaim sea, veechad sheen bo, taval beachad mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen taval, sefeko tahor. rabbi yose metamme, sherabbi yose omer, kol davar shehu vechezkat tuma, leolam hu vifsulo, ad sheyyivvada shettahar. aval sefeko littame uletamme, tahor:
2.3: Sefek mayim sheuvin shettiharu chachamim, safek naflu, safek lo naflu, afillu naflu, safek yesh bahem arbaim sea safek en bahem, shene mikvaot, echad yesh bo arbaim sea veechad en bo, nafal leachad mehen veeno yodea leeze mehen nafal, sefeko tahor, mippene sheyyesh lo vamme yitle. hayu shenehem pechutim mearbaim sea, venafal leachad mehem veeno yodea leeze mehen nafal, sefeko tame, mippene sheen lo vamme yitle:
2.4: Rabbi eliezer omer, reviit mayim sheuvin battechilla, poslin et hammikve, ushelosha luggin al pene hammayim. vachachamim omrim, ben battechilla ben bassof, shiuro shelosha luggin:
2.5: Mikve sheyyesh bo shalosh gummot shel mayim sheuvin shel log log, im yadua shennafal letocho arbaim sein mayim kesherin ad shello higgiu laggumma hashshelishit, kasher. veim lav, pasul. verabbi shimon machshir, mippene shehu chemikve samuch lemikve:
2.6: Hamesannek et hattit latztzedadin umashchu mimmennu shelosha luggin, kasher. haya tolesh umashchu mimmennu shelosha luggin, pasul. verabbi shimon machshir, mippene shello nitkavven lishov:
2.7: Hammanniach kankannim berosh haggag lenaggevan venitmalleu mayim, rabbi eliezer omer, im onat geshamim hi, im yesh bo chimat mayim babbor, yeshabber. veim lav, lo yeshabber. rabbi yehoshua omer, ben kach uven kach yeshabber, o yichpe, aval lo yeare:
2.8: Hassayyad sheshshachach atzitz babbor venitmalle mayim, im hayu hammayim tzafim al gabbav kol shehu, yeshabber. veim lav, lo yeshabber, divre rabbi eliezer. verabbi yehoshua omer, ben kach uven kach yeshabber:
2.9: Hamesadder kankannim betoch habbor venitmalleu mayim, af al pi shebbala habbor et memav, hare ze yeshabber:
2.10: Mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mayim vatit, rabbi eliezer omer, matbilin bammayim veen matbilin battit. rabbi yehoshua omer, bammayim uvattit. beeze tit matbilin. betit shehammayim tzafim al gabbav. hayu hammayim mitztzad echad, mode rabbi yehoshua shemmatbilin bammayim veen matbilin battit. beeze tit amru. betit shehakkane yored meelav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, mekom sheen kene hammidda omed. abba elazar ben dolay omer, mekom shehammishkolet yoredet. rabbi eliezer omer, hayyored befi chavit. rabbi shimon omer, hannichnas bishfoferet hannod. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer, hannimdad ballog:

3.1: Rabbi yose omer, shene mikvaot sheen bahem arbaim sea, venaflu laze log umechetza velaze log umechetza venitarvu, kesherim, mippene shello nikra alehen shem pesul. aval mikve sheen bo arbaim sea venaflu vo shelosha luggin venechelak lishnayim, pasul, mippene shennikra alav shem pesul. verabbi yehoshua machshir, shehaya rabbi yehoshua omer, kol mikve sheen bo arbaim sea venaflu lo shelosha luggin vechasar afillu kortov, kasher, mippene shechasru lo shelosha luggin. vachachamim omrim, leolam hu vifsulo, ad sheyyetze mimmennu meloo vaod:
3.2: Ketzad. habbor shebbechatzer venaflu lo shelosha luggin, leolam hu vifsulo, ad sheyyetze mimmennu meloo vaod, o ad sheyyaamid bechatzer arbaim sea veyitharu haelyonim min hattachtonim. rabbi elazar ben azarya posel, ella im ken pakak:
3.3: Bor shehu male mayim sheuvin vehaamma nichneset lo veyotza mimmennu, leolam hu vifsulo, ad sheyyitchashshev shello nishtayyer min harishonim shelosha luggin. shenayim shehayu mattilin lammikve, ze log umechetza vaze log umechetza, hassochet et kesuto umattil mimmekomot harebe, vehammeare min hatztzartzur umattil mimmekomot harebe, rabbi akiva machshir, vachachamim poslin. amar rabbi akiva, lo amru mattilin, ella mattil. amru lo, lo chach velo chach amru, ella shennaflu lo shelosha luggin:
3.4: Mikkeli echad, mishshenayim umishshelosha, mitztarfin. umearbaa, en mitztarfin. baal keri hachole shennaflu alav tisha kabbin mayim, vetahor shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, mikkeli echad, mishshenayim umishshelosha, mitztarfin. mearbaa, en mitztarfin. bamme devarim amurim. bizman shehitchil hashsheni ad shello fasak harishon. uvamme devarim amurim. bizman shello nitkavven lerabbot. aval nitkavven lerabbot, afillu kortov bechol hashshana, mitztarfin lishlosha luggin:

4.1: Hammanniach kelim tachat hatztzinnor, echad kelim gedolim veechad kelim ketannim, afillu chele gelalim, kele avanim, kele adama, poslin et hammikve. echad hammanniach veechad hashshocheach, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel metaharin beshocheach. amar rabbi meir, nimnu verabbu vet shammay al bet hillel. umodim beshocheach bechatzer shehu tahor. amar rabbi yose, adayin machaloket bimkomah omadet:
4.2: Hammanniach tavla tachat hatztzinnor, im yesh lah levizbez, poselet et hammikve. veim lav, enah poselet et hammikve. zekafah liddoach, ben kach uven kach enah poselet et hammikve:
4.3: Hachotet betzinnor lekabbel tzerorot, beshel etz, kol shehu. uveshel cheres, reviit. rabbi yose omer, af beshel cheres, kol shehu. lo amru reviit ella veshivre chele cheres. hayu tzerorot mitchalchalim betocho, poslim et hammikve. yarad letocho afar venichbash, kasher. sillon shehu tzar mikkan umikkan verachav min haemtza, eno fosel, mippene shello naasa lekabbala:
4.4: Mayim sheuvin ume geshamim shennitarvu vechatzer, uvaukka, veal maalot hammeara, im rov min hakkasher, kasher. veim rov min happasul, pasul. mechetza lemechetza, pasul. ematay, bizman shemmitarvin ad shello yaggiu lammikve. hayu mekallechin betoch hammayim, im yadua shennafal letocho arbaim sea mayim kesherim, ad shello yarad letocho shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, kasher. veim lav, pasul:
4.5: Hashshoket shebbassela, en memallein mimmenna, veen mekaddeshin bah, veen mazzin mimmenna, veenah tzericha tzamid patil, veenah poselet et hammikve. hayta cheli vechibberah besid, memallein bah, umekaddeshin bah, umazzin mimmenna, utzericha tzamid patil, ufoselet et hammikve. nikkeva millematta o min hatztzad veenah yechola lekabbel mayim kol shehem, keshera. vechamma yihye vannekev. kishfoferet hannod. amar rabbi yehuda ben betera, maase veshoket yehu shehayta virushalayim, vehayta nekuva chishfoferet hannod, vehayu chol hattohorot shebbirushalayim naasot al gabbah, veshalchu vet shammay ufechatuha, shebbet shammay omrim, ad sheyyifchatu rubbah:

5.1: Mayan sheheeviro al gabbe hashshoket, pasul. heeviro al gabbe safa chol shehu, kasher chutza lah, shehammayan metaher bechol shehu. heeviro al gabbe verecha vehifsiko, hare hu chemikve. chazar vehimshicho, pasul lazzavim velamtzoraim ulekaddesh mehen me chattat, ad sheyyeda sheyyatzu harishonim:
5.2: Heeviro al gabbe chelim o al gabbe safsal, rabbi yehuda omer, hare hu chemo shehaya. rabbi yose omer, hare hu chemikve, uvilvad shello yatbil al gabbe hassafsal:
5.3: Mayan shehu mashuch kenadal, ribba alav vehimshicho, hare hu chemo shehaya. haya omed veribba alav vehimshicho, shave lemikve letaher beashboren, ulemayan lehatebil bo bechol shehu:
5.4: Kol hayyammim kemikve, shenneemar (Bereshit 1), ulemikve hammayim kara yammim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, hayyam haggadol kemikve. lo neemar yammim, ella sheyyesh bo mine yammim harebe. rabbi yose omer, kol hayyammim metaharim bezochalin, ufesulin lazzavin velamtzoraim, ulekaddesh mehem me chattat:
5.5: Hazzochalin, kemayan. vehannotfim, kemikve. heid rabbi tzadok al hazzochalin sherabbu al hannotfim, shehem kesherim. venotfim sheasaan zochalin, somech afillu makkel, afillu kane, afillu zav vezava, yored vetovel, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, kol davar shehu mekabbel tuma, en mazchilin bo:
5.6: Gal shennitlash uvo arbaim sea, venafal al haadam veal hakkelim, tehorim. kol makom sheyyesh bo arbaim sea, tovlin umatbilin. matbilin bacharitzin uvinatzim uvefarsat hachamor hameorevet babbika. bet shammay omrim, matbilin bechardalit. bet hillel omrim, en matbilin. umodim shehu goder kelim vetovel bahem. vechelim sheggadar bahem, lo hutbelu:

6.1: Kol hameorav lammikve, kammikve. chore hammeara vesidke hammeara, matbil bahem kema shehem. ukkat hammeara, en matbilin bah ella im ken hayta nekuva chishfoferet hannod. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehi maamedet atzmah. aval im enah maamedet atzmah, matbilin bah kema shehi:
6.2: Deli shehu male chelim vehitbilan, hare ellu tehorim. veim lo taval, en hammayim meoravin, ad sheyyihyu meoravin kishfoferet hannod:
6.3: Shelosha mikvaot, baze esrim sea, uvaze esrim sea, uvaze esrim sea mayim sheuvin, vehashshauv min hatztzad, veyardu shelosha vetavlu vahen venitarvu, hammikvaot tehorin vehattovlim tehorim. haya hashshauv baemtza, veyardu shelosha vetavlu vahem venitarvu, hammikvaot kemot shehayu, vehattovlim kemot shehayu:
6.4: Hassefog vehaddeli shehayu vahen shelosha luggin mayim venaflu lammikve, lo fesaluhu, shello amru ella shelosha luggin shennaflu:
6.5: Hashshidda vehatteva shebbayyam, en matbilin bahem, ella im ken hayu nekuvin kishfoferet hannod. rabbi yehuda omer, bichli gadol, arbaa tefachim. uvekatan, rubbo. im haya sak o kuppa, matbilin bahem kema shehem, mippene shehammayim meoravin. hayu netunim tachat hatztzinnor, enam poslim et hammikve, ella matbilin otan umaalin otan kedarkan:
6.6: Gistera shebbammikve vehitbil bah et hakkelim, taharu mittumatan, aval temeim al gav keli cheres. im hayu hammayim tzafim al gabbav kol shehen, tehorin. mayan hayyotze min hattannur veyarad vetaval betocho, hu tahor veyadav temeot. veim hayu al gabbav rum yadav, af yadav tehorot:
6.7: Eruv mikvaot, kishfoferet hannod, keavyah vechachalalah, kishte etzbaot chozrot limkoman. safek kishfoferet hannod, safek sheenah kishfoferet hannod, pesula, mippene shehi min hattora. vechen kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz. kol sheyyaamod kishfoferet hannod, memaatah. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol shehu mibberiyyat hammayim, tahor:
6.8: Metaharim et hammikvaot, haelyon min hattachton, veharachok min hakkarov. ketzad. mevi sillon shel cheres o shel avar, umanniach yado tachtav, ad shehu mitmalle mayim, umoshcho umashshiko, afillu chassaara, dayyo. haya vaelyon arbaim sea uvattachton en kelum, memalle vakkatef venoten laelyon, ad sheyyerdu lattachton arbaim sea:
6.9: Kotel shebben shete mikvaot shennisdak lashsheti, mitztaref. velaerev, en mitztaref, ad sheyyehe vemakom echad kishfoferet hannod. rabbi yehuda omer, chilluf haddevarim. nifretzu ze vetoch ze, al rum, kiklippat hashshum. veal rochav, kishfoferet hannod:
6.10: Haavik shebbammerchatz, bizman shehu vaemtza, posel. min hatztzad, eno fosel, mippene shehu chemikve samuch lemikve, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, im mekabbelet haambati reviit ad shello yaggiu laavik, kasher. veim lav, pasul. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer, im mekabbel haavik kol shehu, pasul:
6.11: Hammatheret shebbammerchatz, hattachtona melea sheuvin vehaelyona melea chesherin, im yesh keneged hannekev shelosha luggin, pasul. kamma yehe vannekev veyihye vo shelosha luggin. achad mishshelosh meot veesrim labberecha, divre rabbi yose. verabbi elazar omer, afillu hattachtona melea chesherim vehaelyona melea sheuvin veyesh betzad hannekev shelosha luggin, kasher, shello amru ella shelosha luggin shennaflu:

7.1: Yesh maalin et hammikve velo foslin, poslin velo maalin, lo maalin velo foslin. ellu maalin velo foslin, hashsheleg, vehabbarad, vehakkefor, vehaggelid, vehammelach, vehattit hannarok. amar rabbi akiva, haya rabbi yishmael dan kenegdi lomar, hashsheleg eno maale et hammikve. veheidu anshe medva mishshemo sheamar lahem, tzeu vehaviu sheleg vaasu mikve battechilla. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, even habbarad, kammayim. ketzad maalin velo foslin. mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser achat, nafal mehem sea letocho veheelahu, nimtzeu maalin velo foslin:
7.2: Ellu foslin velo maalin, hammayim, ben temeim ben tehorim, ume chevashim ume shelakot, vehattemed ad shello hechemitz. ketzad poslin velo maalin. mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser kortov, venafal mehen kortov letocho, lo heelahu, poslo vishlosha luggin. aval shear hammashkin, ume ferot, vehatztzir, vehammuryas, vehattemed mishshehechemitz, peamim maalin ufeamim sheenan maalin. ketzad. mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser achat, nafal letocho sea mehem, lo heelahu. hayu vo arbaim sea, natan sea venatal sea, hare ze chasher:
7.3: Hediach bo salle zetim vesalle anavim, veshinnu et marav, kasher. rabbi yose omer, me hatztzeva poslin oto vishlosha luggin, veenan poslin oto veshinnuy mare. nafal letocho yayin, umochal, veshinnu et marav, pasul. ketzad yaase. yamtin lo ad sheyyerdu geshamim veyachzeru marehen lemare hammayim. hayu vo arbaim sea, memalle vakkatef venoten letocho ad sheyyachzeru marehen lemare hammayim:
7.4: Nafal letocho yayin o mochal veshinnu miktzat marav, im en bo mare mayim arbaim sea, hare ze lo yitbol bo:
7.5: Shelosha luggin mayim, venafal letochan kortov yayin, vahare marehen kemare hayyayin, venaflu lemikve, lo fesaluhu. shelosha luggin mayim chaser kortov, venafal letochan kortov chalav, vahare marehen kemare hammayim, venaflu lemikve, lo fesaluhu. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, hakkol holech achar hammare:
7.6: Mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuvvanot, yardu shenayim vetavlu ze achar ze, harishon tahor, vehashsheni tame. rabbi yehuda omer, im hayu raglav shel rishon nogot bammayim, af hashsheni tahor. hitbil bo et hassagos veheelahu, miktzato nogea bammayim, tahor. hakkar vehakkeset shel or, kevan shehigbiah siftotehem min hammayim, hammayim shebbetochan sheuvin. ketzad yaase, matbilan umaale otam derech shulehem:
7.7: Hitbil bo et hammitta, af al pi sheragleha shokot battit heave, tehora, mippene shehammayim mekaddemin. mikve shemmemav meruddadin, kovesh afillu chavile etzim, afillu chavile kanim, kede sheyyitpechu hammayim, veyored vetovel. machat shehi netuna al maalot hammeara, haya molich umevi vammayim, kevan sheavar aleha haggal, tehora:

8.1: Eretz yisrael tehora, umikveoteha tehorim. mikveot haammim shebbechutza laaretz, kesherim levaale kerayin, afillu nitmalleu vekilon. shebbeeretz yisrael, shechutz lammafteach, kesherim af leniddot. millifnim min hammafteach, kesherim levaale kerayin, ufesulim lechol hattemeim. rabbi eliezer omer, hakkerovim lair veladderech, temeim, mippene hakkevisa. veharchokim, tehorim:
8.2: Ellu vaale kerayin shehem tzerichin tevila. raa mayim chalukim o achurim, battechilla, tahor. baemtza uvassof, tame. mittechilla vead sof, tahor. levanim venimshachim, tame. rabbi yose omer, levanim kaachurim:
8.3: Hammetil tippin avot mittoch haamma, tame, divre rabbi elazar chisma. hameharher ballayla veamad umatza vesaro cham, tame. happoletet zera bayyom hashshelishi, tehora, divre rabbi elazar ben azarya. rabbi yishmael omer, peamim shehem arba onot, peamim shehem chamesh, peamim shehem shesh. rabbi akiva omer, leolam chamesh:
8.4: Nachrit sheppalta shichvat zera miyyisrael, temea. bat yisrael sheppalta shichvat zera minnachri, tehora. haishsha sheshshimmesha vetah, veyarda vetavla, velo chibbeda et habbayit, keillu lo tavla. baal keri shettaval velo hetil et hammayim, kesheyatil et hammayim, tame. rabbi yose omer, bechole uvezaken, tame. beyeled uvevari, tahor:
8.5: Nidda shennatna maot befiha veyarda vetavla, tehora mittumatah, aval temea hi al gav rukkah. natna searah befiha, kaftza yadah, kartza siftoteha, keillu lo tavla. haochez beadam uvechelim umatbilan, temein. veim hediach et yado bammayim, tehorim. rabbi shimon omer, yerappe, kede sheyyavou vahem mayim. bet hassetarim, bet hakkematim, enan tzerichin sheyyavou vahen mayim:

9.1: Ellu chotztzin baadam, chute tzemer vechute fishtan vehartzuot shebberashe habbanot. rabbi yehuda omer, shel tzemer veshel sear enam chotztzin, mippene shehammayim bain bahem:
9.2: Kilke hallev vehazzakan, uvet hassetarim baishsha, lifluf shechutz laayin, vegeled shechutz lammakka, vehartiyya shealeha, useraf hayyavesh, vegilde tzoa sheal besaro, uvatzek shettachat hatztzipporen, vehammilmulin, vetit hayyaven, vetit hayyotzrim, vegetz yeveni. ezehu tit hayyaven, ze tit habborot, shenneemar (tehillim 40), vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven. tit hayyotzrin, kemashmao. rabbi yose metaher beshel yotzrin umetamme beshel mareka. vegetz yeveni, ellu yitdot hadderachim, sheen tovlin bahen velo matbilin otan. ushear kol hattit, matbilin bo keshehu lach. velo yitbol baavak sheal raglav. lo yitbol et hakkumkemus bappechamin, ella im ken shifshef:
9.3: Ellu sheen chotztzin, kilke harosh, uvet hashshechi, uvet hassetarim baish. rabbi eliezer omer, echad haish veechad haishsha, kol hammakpid alav, chotzetz. vesheen makpid alav, en chotzetz:
9.4: Lifluf shebbaayin, vegeled sheal hammakka, useraf hallach, velichluche tzoa sheal besaro, vetzoa shettachat hatztzipporen, vetzipporen hameduldelet, keshut shel katan, lo tame velo metamme. kerum sheal hammakka, tame umetamme:
9.5: Ellu chotztzim bakkelim. hazzefet vehammor bichle zechuchit, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz. al hashshulchan veal hattavla veal haddargash, al hannekiyyim, chotztzin. al habbelusin, enan chotztzin. al mittot baal habbayit, chotzetz. veal shel ani, eno chotzetz. al ikkuf shel baal habbayit, chotzetz. veal shel zakkakin, eno chotzetz. veal hammardaat, chotzetz. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ad keissar haitalki:
9.6: Al habbegadim, mitztzad echad, eno chotzetz. mishshene tzedadin, chotzetz. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yishmael, af mitztzad echad. rabbi yose omer, shel bannaim, mitztzad echad. veshel bur, mishshene tzedadin:
9.7: Mitpachat shel zappatin veshel yotzrin veshel mefassele ilanot, en chotztzin. rabbi yehuda omer, af shel kayyatzin, kayyotze vahen. ze hakkelal, kol hammakpid alav, chotzetz. vesheeno makpid alav, eno chotzetz:

10.1: Kol yedot hakkelim shehichnisan shello chedarkan, o shehichnisan kedarkan velo merkan, o shemmerkan venishberu, hare ellu chotztzin. keli shehitbilo derech piv, keillu lo taval. hitbilo chedarko velo zibborit, ad sheyyattennu al tziddo. keli shehu tzar mikkan umikkan verachav min haemtza, eno tahor ad sheyyattennu al tziddo. tzelochit sheppiha shokea, enah tehora ad sheyyenakkevenna mitztziddah. kalmarin hedyotot, enah tehora ad sheyyenakkevenna mitztziddah. vekalmarin shel yosef hakkohen hayta nekuva vetziddah:
10.2: Hakkar vehakkeset shel or, hare ellu tzerichin sheyyavou vahem hammayim. keset agulla, vehakkaddur, vehaemum, vehakkamea, vehattefilla, enan tzerichin sheyyavou vahem hammayim. ze hakkelal, kol sheen darko lehachenis ulehotzi, tovlim setumim:
10.3: Ellu sheenam tzerichim sheyyavou vahem hammayim, kishre heani, vehannimin, vachavat shel sandal, utefilla shel rosh bizman shehi chotza, veshel zeroa bizman sheenah ola veyoredet, veazne hachemet, veazne hattarmul:
10.4: Ellu shehem tzerichim sheyyavou vahen hammayim, hakkesher shebbapperaksim shebbakkatef, vesafa shel sadin tzarich lematteach, utefilla shel rosh bizman sheenah chotza, veshel zeroa bizman shehi ola veyoredet, ushenatzin shel sandal, uvegadim shehitbilan mechubbasin, ad sheyyevabeu. hitbilan neguvin, ad sheyyevabeu veyanuchu mibbibuan:
10.5: Kol yedot hakkelim shehem arukkin veatid liktzotz, matbilan ad mekom hammidda. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyatbil et kullo. shalshelet deli gadol, arbaa tefachim, veshel katan, asara, matbilan ad mekom hammidda. rabbi tarfon omer, ad sheyyatbil et kol hattabbaat. hachevel shehu kashur bakkuppa eno chibbur, ella im ken tafar:
10.6: Bet shammay omrim, en matbilin chammin betzonen velo tzonen bechammin, lo yafim beraim velo raim beyafim. bet hillel omrim, matbilin. keli shehu male mashkin vehitbilo, keillu lo taval. male me raglayim, roim otam keillu hem mayim. male me chattat, ad sheyyirbu hammayim al me chattat. rabbi yose omer, afillu cheli machazik kor veen bo ella reviit, keillu lo taval:
10.7: Kol hoochalin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya bechachatzi feras. kol hammashkin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya birviit. ze chomer beshote mashkin temein mibbammikve, sheasu vo shear hammashkin kammayim:
10.8: Achal ochalim temeim, veshata mashkim temeim, taval vehekian, temeim, mippene sheenan tehorim bagguf. shata mayim temeim, taval vehekiam, tehorim, mippene shehem tehorim bagguf. bala tabbaat tehora, nichnas leohel hammet, hizza veshana vetaval vehekiah, hare hi chemot shehayta. bala tabbaat temea, tovel veochel batteruma. hekiah, temea vetimmeattu. chetz shehu tachuv baadam, bizman shehu nire, chotzetz. veim eno nire, tovel veochel bitrumato:
